title: Best Arm Identification with Unknown Post-Action Context Distribution
abstract: arXiv:2611.33024v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study best arm identification (BAI) with post-action context in the fixed-confidence setting. After choosing an action, the learner observes a post-action context together with a reward whose distribution depends only on this context. Incorporating such intermediate information can substantially reduce the sample complexity of identifying the best arm. While Shahverdikondori et al. (2026a) analyzed the case where the distribution of contexts given actions is known, we address the more challenging and practically relevant case where this distribution is unknown. We derive an instance-dependent sample complexity lower bound and propose a Track-and-Stop algorithm that matches it asymptotically with access to an optimization oracle. Our stopping rule uses a new concentration inequality that jointly controls uncertainty in the context distributions and reward means, removing the factor of two incurred by separate concentration bounds. translated_title: 未知动作后上下文分布下的最优臂识别
translated_abstract: 我们研究了固定置信度设置下具有动作后上下文的最优臂识别（BAI）问题。在选择一个动作之后，学习器会观察到一个动作后上下文以及一个奖励，而该奖励的分布仅取决于此上下文。引入这种中间信息可以大幅降低识别最优臂所需的样本复杂度。虽然 Shahverdikondori 等人（2026a）分析了动作对应的上下文分布已知的情况，但我们解决了更具挑战性且更具实际意义的情况，即该分布是未知的。我们推导了一个依赖实例的样本复杂度下界，并提出了一种 Track-and-Stop 算法，在获得优化预言机的情况下，该算法能够渐进地匹配该下界。我们的停止规则采用了一种新的集中不等式，能够联合控制上下文分布和奖励均值中的不确定性，从而消除了分别使用集中界所带来的两倍因子损失。
tldr: 该论文研究了上下文分布未知的动作后上下文最优臂识别问题，推导了依赖实例的样本复杂度下界，并提出了一种基于新型集中不等式、能够渐进匹配该下界的 Track-and-Stop 算法。
en_tdlr: This paper studies best arm identification with unknown post-action context distributions, deriving an instance-dependent sample complexity lower bound and proposing a Track-and-Stop algorithm that asymptotically matches it using a novel concentration inequality that jointly controls context and reward uncertainty.
